violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. PIC recently took class (9/24/26), but does not have results/certificate yet. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 10/08/2024

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC took slice out of service to be washed/sanitized. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 10/05/2026

Pizza, fried chicken, and empanadas were observed held between 112-128 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC reheated or discarded items based on quality. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/05/2026

Various items were observed held between 53-55 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC discarded or placed in walk-in cooler for active cooling. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/05/2026

Inspector observed meowing from basement area. PIC removed cat from establishment. Animals are not allowed in food establishments unless they are a service dog. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/05/2026

The presence of small flies and roaches are not controlled as evidenced by live small flies and roaches. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2026

The door to the outside, located in the front, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2026
Inspector observed clean/sanitized dishes stored next to mop sink. PIC informed to install a splash guard/divider that is non-absorbent and easily cleanable. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the storage racks (including walk-in cooler racks) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2026
Inspector observed litter and debris around outside grease receptacle. Area to be maintained clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2026
The ceiling in the prep area is covered with tiles that are not smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. New Violation. Correct By: 10/31/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 10/08/2024
The hand-washing sink in the bathroom was lacking paper towels. PIC replaced. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2026

Raw animal foods (such as eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as deli meat) in the prep unit. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. PIC relocated eggs. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener, slicer, cheese shredder attachment) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC took units out of service to be washed/sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2026

Per interview of staff, slicers are only washed, rinsed, and sanitized at the end of the week. The surfaces of equipment that contacts time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as meats and cheeses must be washed, rinsed, and sanitized at least every four hours. New Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2026

Ham was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. PIC labeled. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2026
Working containers used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. PIC labeled. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2026

The presence of small flies and rodents are not controlled as evidenced by live small flies and small droppings. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2026
Inspector observed dead mouse in trap under mop sink in kitchen area. New Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2026

The door to the outside, located in the front, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2026
Various items were observed stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2026
Inspector observed clean/sanitized dishes stored next to mop sink. PIC informed to install a splash guard/divider that is non-absorbent and easily cleanable. New Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2026

Inspector observed the following: - handle to cheese shredder attachment wrapped with tape - prep unit (under hood) with tape - cardboard lined kitchen/cooler shelves Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning must be constructed of a nonabsorbent and smooth material. New Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine AND quat sanitizing solution for the 3 bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of food and equipment storage shelves in kitchen areas and walk-in unit have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2026
Inspector observed stagnant water in mop bucket. New Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2026

Inspector observed the following in poor repair: - hand-washing sink in kitchen (slow draining plumbing and leak into container below). - grease trap in kitchen (leak into container below). New Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2026
Inspector observed liter and debris around outside grease receptacle. Area to be maintained clean. New Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2026
The following was observed in poor repair. - wall in bathroom (hole) - floor behind prep unit (hole)The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 10/07/2026

The floors throughout the facility have an accumulation of soil residue rodent droppings, and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 10/08/2024
Cheese in the 4dr cooler was observed with mold and black residue.PIC voluntarily disposed of product. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/08/2024

The non-food contact surfaces of the (hood vents and food storage shelves in walk in cooler and 4 dr reach in ) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 10/08/2024

Unnecessary, non-functional equipment, litter, and/or items were observed in the (outside back) area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 10/08/2024

The following physical facilities observed in poor repair: 1.hole observed near back door. 2.ceiling has exposed insulation. 3.ceilings in bathroom observed with missing tile. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 10/08/2024

The floors in walk in cooler have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 10/08/2024
